in_sanskrit.name: सारिक
in_sanskrit.meaning: Possible meanings in Sanskrit: 1. One who carries something, 2. One who is skilled, 3. One who is a trader.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sarik could have originated from the Sanskrit word 'sārik' which has multiple meanings. It could mean 'one who carries something' or 'one who is skilled'. Alternatively, it could also mean 'one who is a trader'.

in_hindi.name: सारिक
in_hindi.meaning: सारीक (sārīk) - व्यक्ति जो कुछ धन्य वस्तु को धरते है (carries something), कार्यकार्ता (skilled), वास्तुकोश (trader).
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Sarik (सारिक) can be translated to 'sārīk' which means 'one who carries something', 'skilled', or 'trader'.

in_tamil.name: சாரிக்
in_tamil.meaning: பிழையால் செய்தல் வாழ்ந்த பேர் (one who does work with great effort), குழந்தை (skilled), வேகையாளர் (trader).
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Sarik (சாரிக்) could mean 'one who does work with great effort', 'skilled', or 'trader'.

in_telugu.name: సారిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Sarik (సారిక) could mean 'carries something', 'skilled', or 'trader'.

in_marathi.name: Sarik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the master and protector of the forest, usually associated with Saraswati or Ganesha.

in_bengali.name: Sarik
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Forest
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sarik একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the master and protector of the forest, usually associated with Saraswati or Ganesha.
